name: claude-mem-sot-adapter
purpose: Proposta de integração governada de memória persistente para sessões Claude Code do SOT.
constraints: Memory is supplemental context, never normative authority.
Memory must not override AGENTS.md, governance, canon, ROADMAP.md, or atomic-spec.md.
Raw secrets, credentials, private keys, and tokens must not be persisted.
No memory runtime data may be committed to the repository.
Deletion and retention changes require explicit human approval.
review_required_before_activation: manual smoke test completed in a disposable Claude Code profile
